plugins.name: gdd-forge
plugins.description: Gate-driven Game Design Document generator: asks for missing decisions, never invents them, then forges a 13-chapter GDD in one checkpointed multi-agent workflow — specialised subagents write, adversarial verifiers check every chapter, and a verified review drives fix rounds, pausing at checkpoints to ask you.
